falsification_conditions.condition: S&P 500 closes above 5,600 on any single day within the next 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A decisive breakout above the August 2024 recovery high would invalidate the bottom pattern match, as it would signal the correction ended earlier and a new uptrend is established, making 'bottom' timing wrong

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes below 14.00 for 3 consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: Sustained complacency at pre-correction volatility levels would falsify the bottom thesis, as genuine bottoms typically feature elevated volatility that gradually resolves, not an immediate return to risk-on complacency

falsification_conditions.condition: 10Y-2Y Treasury yield curve steepens to +50 basis points or wider (un-inverts)
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A normalization of the yield curve without accompanying equity weakness would indicate the macro slowdown signal was a false alarm, undermining the recessionary bottom narrative that the 77% pattern match implies

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
